description.en:
Copies the match's goal log (the goals recorded with CMND_BTL_SET_POINT_HISTORY) to a store that outlives the match, so that a later match can restore it with CMND_BTL_LOAD_HISTORY.
The story uses the pair for a match split into two scripts with an event in between: btl0015.nut saves the log when it ends, and btl0016.nut loads it when it begins, so the score carries over.
Only the first 200 bytes of the log are copied: 16 goal entries of 12 bytes, plus part of a 17th.

true once the log has been copied.
false if the store is not available.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Keeping the goals of the first part of a split match (real usage, from btl0015.nut)
